name: Dys-
source:
A would-be writer, beset by emotional issues, lives life minute-to-minute, until a string of strange events conspire to reveal that life isn't at all what it seemed.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27051]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一名想成为作家的人饱受情感问题的困扰，过着分分秒秒的生活，直到一系列奇怪的事件共同揭示出生活根本不是看上去的那样。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27051]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
